entry.author: Kordia
entry.summary:
How can New Zealand sporting organisations and broadcasters better access international content? Meet Arqade.

In this clip, Kordia’s Matt Patterson and Arqiva’s Alaina Hall discuss this "cloud-based content interchange platform" that is already delivering success for local organisations like NZR+. Whether it’s 24/7 channels or live global sports, the Kordia-Arqiva partnership is bringing the world’s content to NZ shores.

Explore our content distribution capabilities: 👉 https://www.kordia.co.nz/broadcast/cloud-and-ott-solutions
